learner_operation: Find the original column indices that become leading entries after row-echelon reduction; moderate cases require one row swap, then complete checkbox selection.

fixed_features.feature: Moderate profile uses exactly one row swap on sparse 3x3, 3x4, or 4x4 matrices.
fixed_features.justification: All six moderate source questions have this workload; adding elimination would increase difficulty. Row-leading inspection is a valid mathematical simplification in this family.

fixed_features.feature: At least two pivot columns and at least one nonpivot column; numeric entries are small integers.
fixed_features.justification: All supplied source practice uses nontrivial subset selection with at least two pivots and both positive and negative choices; moderate rank one/full column rank would reduce the instructional decision. These restrictions retain the demonstrated skill and workload.

fixed_features.feature: One checkbox per original column, with original column vectors.
fixed_features.justification: The moderate source response contract is complete subset selection, not rank entry or transformed-column identification.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary leading, internal and terminal nonpivot roles and eligible pivot subsets at each supported shape.
answer_roles.observed: 60 moderate samples cover all ten eligible subsets across 3/4 columns; explicit boundary assignments reach earliest and latest subsets. The delivered five contain three subsets.

answer_roles.role: Correct choice count and displayed position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Rank 2/3 at four columns; original column number follows matrix ordering. Hard radio correct entry and size vary.
answer_roles.observed: Both ranks occur for 3x4 and 4x4; 3x3 rank2 justified as the nontrivial comparable subset task. Hard radio profiles have size2/3 keys and different bank positions.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: A/B/P and signs/nonleading values may change without assigning a response.
answer_roles.observed: Fixed subset probes fail within nontrivial label and shape groups; irrelevant nonleading change preserves membership.

coverage.result: 17 source answer banks replayed; canonical reconstructed; earliest/latest eligible subsets accepted at supported shapes.
60/60 accepted, no decision-case loss, ten distinct complete subsets.
5/5 accepted; subsets {1,3,4}, {1,2}, {1,3}. Three 4x4 records include {1,2} and {1,3}; no tested full-answer surface cue solves all five.
Six samples per each of six profiles, including swaps, eliminations, mixed cases and five-entry radio banks.

counterfactuals.change: Hold [[1,2,5],[0,0,0],[0,4,3]] fixed except change row3 column2 from 4 to 0.
counterfactuals.expected: Pivot subset changes {1,2} -> {1,3}; answer vectors, conclusion, rendering and native grader must follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact independent reduction, solution matrices and complete native true/false checks match changed selection; rendered records 6/7 exhibit this change.
counterfactuals.justification: Both are sparse one-swap moderate instances; changing a leading entry changes the decision while preserving workload.

counterfactuals.change: Hold the base fixed except row1 column3 from 5 to -5.
counterfactuals.expected: Keep pivot subset {1,2}, with the changed original vector and solution matrices.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent matrix checks and native checks preserve selection; rendered records 6/8 show the changed entry and unchanged answers.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing a nonleading coefficient in this REF-permutation task does not move row-leading positions.

stages_examined: actual publisher normalization and inventory/batch deduplication
learner band selection, entity ordering, freshness and no-policy fallback
delivery.result: No rejection/deduplication loss of the sampled decision cases. Uniform-within-band selection preserves possible outcomes; fresh selection from exact new batch reaches all five. Captured inventory and inactive previews only, no publication.

limitations: Finite probes cover tested cue strategies, not every shortcut.
No active policy or learner history is captured; selection is evaluated structurally and in reproducible preview configurations.
Canonical source has no fields, so its response contract is inferred from adjacent practice while its matrix/solution is checked directly.
Hard material was sampled conservatively for fidelity and profiles; requested batch is moderate.
